seo.title: ODDspace membership — €150 / month in Vallila, Helsinki
seo.description: One flat membership: 24/7 access to the ODDspace co-working space, shared facilities and meeting rooms, and member rates on the event spaces and ODDstudio. Everything you need to decide, before you get in touch.

intro: Everything you need to decide is on this page. If something isn't here, ask us — we would rather tell you than let you find out later.

whatItIs.headline: A desk, a door code, and people who make things.
whatItIs.body: Membership is day-to-day access to ODDspace: somewhere to work, meeting rooms when you need them, and a building where people from art, design, music, media, technology and business are working on their own things under one roof. One flat rate, no tiers, no long-term commitment.

included.headline: What's included
items: Shared working areas, WiFi, kitchen and the basics
Meeting rooms when you need them
Member rates on the gallery, the auditorium and ODDstudio
Member and community events in the space, as they run

notIncluded.headline: What's not included
items: ODDstudio. The recording and production room is booked separately — add full access for €100 / month on top of membership, or book it at €20 / hour as a member.
Event bookings. Using the gallery or the auditorium for your own event is booked and priced separately, at member rates.
A private office or a fixed, reserved desk. ODDspace is a shared working space.
notIncluded.note: If you are weighing the studio add-on, the full rates, equipment and booking terms are on the ODDstudio page.

ratesNote: Member rates on the event spaces: €200 for a full day in the 1st floor gallery, €100 for a half day in the auditorium. Everyone else books from the published rate card, which starts at €300 — so a member running a series saves most of the difference. Booking the studio by the hour does not require a membership.

howItWorks.title: Tell us about you
howItWorks.body: A short message about what you do and how you would use the space. Say if you want to visit first — most people do.

howItWorks.title: We check the fit and availability
howItWorks.body: Memberships are accepted on a rolling basis while the pilot has room. We come back to you either way.

howItWorks.title: Start using the space
howItWorks.body: You get your access details and onboarding, and the door code works 24/7 from day one.

faq.question: What does it cost?
faq.answer: €150 per month, one flat rate — no tiers. ODDstudio is the one thing not covered by it.

faq.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
faq.answer: No. It is a flexible monthly membership with no long-term commitment during the pilot phase.

faq.question: Can I visit before joining?
faq.answer: Yes, and we would rather you did. Mention it in your message and we'll set up a time to show you around.

faq.question: Is it really 24/7?
faq.answer: Yes — members have their own access to the co-working space around the clock, not only during office hours.

faq.question: Do I get my own desk?
faq.answer: It is a shared working space rather than a set of private offices or reserved desks. If a fixed setup matters for your work, tell us what you need and we'll say honestly whether the space can do it.

faq.question: Can I book meeting rooms?
faq.answer: Yes, meeting rooms are part of the membership. For anything bigger — the gallery or the auditorium — see the event spaces, which members book at member rates.

faq.question: Is the studio included?
faq.answer: No. ODDstudio is booked separately: €100 / month on top of membership for full access (€250 / month in total), or €20 / hour as a member. Without a membership the studio rents from €30 / hour. Full rates and equipment are on the ODDstudio page.

faq.question: Can I host my own event in the space as a member?
faq.answer: Yes. Members book the gallery and the auditorium at member rates — €200 for a full day in the gallery, €100 for a half day in the auditorium. You don't need to be a member to book them at all: public rates start at €300 for creative organisations, €450 for a promoter night and €750 for a company half day, all plus VAT.

faq.question: How quickly can I start?
faq.answer: Memberships are accepted on a rolling basis as space becomes available during the pilot, so it depends on where we are when you ask. Tell us the date you'd like to start and we'll tell you whether it works.

faq.question: Is ODDspace accessible?
faq.answer: We do not have verified accessibility information for the building to publish yet — step-free access, lifts, accessible toilets and door widths are still being documented, and we would rather say that than reassure you about something we have not measured. If accessibility matters for your visit, email hello@oddfest.co and we will tell you exactly what the space can and cannot do today.

faq.question: What if I have a question that isn't here?
faq.answer: Email hello@oddfest.co. If it is something we haven't decided yet, we'll say so rather than make something up.

finalCta.headline: Come and see it, then decide.
finalCta.body: Tell us what you do and how you would use the space. A visit is the fastest way to know whether it's right for you.
